effects.effect:
You have an epic resource called [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge). Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you gain [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge) equal to the [XP](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/experience) you gain. You can spend [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge) on your abilities as if it were insight.

Additionally, you can spend [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge) to take additional maneuvers on your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). You can use one maneuver for each [subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge) you spend.

[Subterfuge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.shadow.level-10/subterfuge) remains until you spend it.
